transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. I came in because... well, what started as just trying to eat cleaner for the lieutenant track at work has kind of turned into me cutting my meals way down. I'm basically down to just having black coffee, a protein shake, and a really small dinner. And I'm doing that even on shift days at the firehouse, when I know for a fact I've burned way more than what I'm taking in. I just figured I should probably talk to someone about it.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

Yeah, I am. It's... well, if I step on the scale and it's up even a single pound—even if it's just from drinking extra water or after a big meal at the station—I get this tight panic. I just feel like I've completely blown it, and I start worrying that people are going to see me as soft or just out of control.
Have you become significantly underweight because of the way you’ve been eating?

Yeah, I have. My gear and my station clothes hang a lot looser on me now. Actually, during our last fitness review, they flagged my weight as being too low for my build. But... honestly, even with them telling me that, part of me still feels like I should keep trimming down just a little more.
